thread:
Sam: Heads-up: customers are asking for chargeback-ready cost exports + lower-noise tracing correlation. We need to pick a scope that is deliverable in one sprint. Suggestions?
Irene: Propose 'billing-first' slice: daily per-tenant cost CSV export + an optional tenant filter in dashboard. Don't attempt token-level costing yet.
Jules: Tracing correlation: add a lightweight tenant_trace_id in ingress spans and propagate to logs. No full-span UI this sprint.
Priya: From product: enterprise customers need export format that matches their billing system (CSV with tenant_id, date, token_count_est, cost_usd). Also need retention policy declared.
Carlos: Implementation constraints: billing job can emit daily aggregates with minor change. Adding tenant_trace_id requires minor header parsing and tag propagation in router.
Sam: Launch gate checklist: export schema approved by two customers, e2e export test, docs, privacy review. Canary gates: export size delta < 5%, error rate < 1% on canary traffic.
Irene: Privacy: for sensitive tenants we should offer hashed_tenant_id option. Include a downstream opt-out for exports.
Jules: Sampling experiment: start with 0.5% tracing for all, up to 3% for paying tiers. We'll run A/B with signal quality metric (trace-coverage per error).
Priya: KPIs post-launch: # customers using export, mean time to identify chargeback mismatch, reduction in billing disputes.
Carlos: Rollout: feature flag + 3-stage: internal, partner customers (2), GA. Canary window: 36h representative traffic.
canary-bot: Canary created -> start: 2025-02-10T00:00Z; monitors: export_success_rate, trace_tagging_rate, p99_export_latency. Alerts -> #eng-oncall.
SRE-oncall: Need to reserve a maintenance window for the router deploy. Also track CPU for batch job + memory for temporary export buffer.
Sam: Owners: Irene (billing export + schema), Jules (trace tag + sampling), Priya (customer sign-off + KPIs), Carlos (infra changes + rollout), Sam (PRD + launch decision).
Irene: I'll draft CSV schema and share with two customers for approval by EOD Thursday.
Jules: I'll prototype header parsing and add unit tests. ETA: 6 days.
Carlos: I'll book the maintenance window and coordinate with SRE.
Sam: Decision: ship billing-first minimal slice this sprint; follow up on token-level costing and span UI in Q2. Let's keep the PRD lean.
